# Test Fixtures (`tests/fixtures/`)

Input corpora and generator scripts exercising `commissure probe` (including the per-page PDF readability gate), `commissure run --step ingest`, and `commissure run --step parse`.

> **Folder-walk invariant:** `probe` and `ingest` walk every regular file inside a source directory (`commissure.ingest.iter_folder_files`). Keep documentation (`README.md`), generators (`make_probe_corpus.py`, `make_real_samples.py`, `make_ocr_corpus.py`, `make_recon_corpus.py`), and expectation manifests (`real_samples.expected.json`) at this root level—never inside a corpus subfolder.

---

## Quick Scenario Map

| Target Scenario | Sample Corpus (`real_samples/`) | Deterministic Synthetic (`probe_corpus/`) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Native PDF (text + tables + letter-spaced title + soft hyphen)** | `project_report.pdf` | `native.pdf` |
| **Scanned PDF (image-only, no OCR)** | — | `scanned.pdf`, `mixed.pdf` (p2 stamped) |
| **PDF over full-page image + partial ToUnicode CMap** | `cover_unmapped.pdf` (`unmapped_glyphs` + `full_page_image_under_text`) | `mixed.pdf` (p4 invisible OCR layer) |
| **PDF with Type 3 fonts (named vs. unnamed glyphs)** | `type3_unnamed.pdf` (`font_without_unicode_map`, OCR-readable) | `type3.pdf` (p1 encoded, p2 no `/Encoding`, p3 custom `/gN`) |
| **DOCX with nested headings & tables** | `template.docx` (H1–H4, 2 tables, bold prompts) | `report.docx` (H1–H3, level skip, merged cells) |
| **XLSX with multiple sheets & nulls** | `inventory.xlsx` (2 sheets, title row, nulls) | `workbook.xlsx` (2 sheets, nulls, uncached formulas) |
| **CSV with UTF-8 BOM & quoting defect** | — | `table.csv`, `quoted_bom.csv` (`ragged_rows`) |
| **JSON array** | `events.json` (10-item `list`) | — |

---

## 1. `real_samples/` — Lean Document-Quirk Corpus (`make_real_samples.py`)

Generated by `tests/fixtures/make_real_samples.py` (`uv run python tests/fixtures/make_real_samples.py`) with zero external or government work product. Checked against human-verified expectations in `real_samples.expected.json` by `tests/test_real_samples.py` and against parse goldens in `tests/golden/parse/real_samples/` by `tests/test_parse_golden.py`.

- **`project_report.pdf`**: 2-page born-digital report with a 24pt letter-spaced title (`PROJECT REPORT`, verifying the `0.22 em` font-relative word gap in `commissure/parse/pdf.py`), a line-wrapped soft hyphen (`minority-owned`, verifying PDFium `U+FFFE` hyphen normalization), and a ruled 3x3 table on page 1.
- **`cover_unmapped.pdf`**: 1-page cover over a full-page background image whose font `ToUnicode` CMap omits glyph `0x0001` between `"Department"` and `"of"` (`unmapped_glyphs` + `full_page_image_under_text`; `U+FFFD` replacement in both `pdfplumber` and `pdfium`).
- **`type3_unnamed.pdf`**: 2-page PDF whose Type 3 font uses numeric `/Differences` glyph names (`/0`, `/1`, `/2`, ... starting at code 32) and no `/ToUnicode`, while drawing real bitmap letterforms in its `/CharProcs`. Rejected by the structural gate (`font_without_unicode_map`) and recognised by `parse --parser ocr` via PDFium + Tesseract.
- **`template.docx`**: Word document with 4 headings nested across `Heading 1` through `Heading 4`, 2 tables, 6 body paragraphs, and 2 short bold form prompts flagged as `possible_unstyled_headings`.
- **`inventory.xlsx`**: 2-sheet workbook (`Field Descriptions` with a single-cell title row flagged `possible_title_row`, and `Inventory` with 5 columns, sparse nulls, and a trailing empty row trimmed during `parse_xlsx`).
- **`events.json`**: Top-level JSON array (`list` of 10 records). Counted as `not_inspected` by `probe` and parsed into pretty-printed JSON with `metadata == {"top_level": "list"}` by `parse_json`.

---

## 2. `probe_corpus/` — Deterministic Synthetic Corpus (`make_probe_corpus.py`)

Generated by `tests/fixtures/make_probe_corpus.py` (`uv run python tests/fixtures/make_probe_corpus.py`) so every edge case of the readability gate and tabular/office probes has exact, controlled internal structure. Never hand-edit files in `probe_corpus/`; edit `make_probe_corpus.py` and rerun it.

- **`native.pdf`**: 4 readable native pages designed to catch naive heuristics (dense text, a one-word sparse title page, a 60%-area photo with caption, and dense native text over a full-page letterhead image).
- **`scanned.pdf`**: 2 image-only pages (Letter and A4) with simulated scan bands and no text layer (`image_only`, quarantined).
- **`mixed.pdf`**: 6 pages, one per gate outcome: (1) readable native text, (2) scan with a small Bates/ID stamp (`image_dominant`), (3) `Type0` `Identity-H` font without `ToUnicode` (`undecodable_glyphs` + `font_without_unicode_map`), (4) scan with invisible render-mode-3 OCR text (`full_page_image_under_text`), (5) `blank`, (6) vector bar chart with no text (`no_text_layer`).
- **`type3.pdf`**: 3 spec-compliant `Type3` font pages (no `/BaseFont`):
  1. `/Encoding` `/Differences` mapping ASCII to Adobe Glyph List names -> `readable` (`"Type three font with standard glyph names."`).
  2. No `/Encoding` and no `/ToUnicode` -> `unreadable` (`undecodable_glyphs` + `font_without_unicode_map`).
  3. `/Encoding` `/Differences` mapping codes to custom `/g1`..`/g14` glyph names without `/ToUnicode` (as emitted by legacy `dvips`/bitmap pipelines) -> `unreadable` (`undecodable_glyphs`).
- **`broken.pdf`**: Truncated 300-byte prefix of `native.pdf` (`error` in `probe`, quarantined as `parse_error` in `parse`).
- **`report.docx`**: Headings H1->H2->H3 and H1->H3 (`heading_level_skips`), an all-bold Normal paragraph (`possible_unstyled_headings`), and 2 tables including a horizontal cell merge.
- **`workbook.xlsx`**: 2 sheets (`Data` with typed columns, nulls, and uncached `=C*2` formulas; `Notes` with a single-cell title row above an empty row and key/value table).
- **`table.csv`**: UTF-8 BOM (`utf-8-sig`), semicolon-delimited, with nulls and a short 2-field row (`ragged_rows`).
- **`quoted_bom.csv`**: UTF-8 BOM (`utf-8-sig`), comma-delimited table where row 3 has unescaped inner quotes around a comma-bearing string, causing `csv.reader` to leave quote mode early and split the field into a 5th column (`ragged_rows`).
- **`notes.txt`**: Plain text file with no registered probe/parser (`not_inspected` in `probe`, `skipped` with `no_parser` in `parse`).

---

## 3. `ocr_corpus/` — Image-Only PDFs for the `ocr` Parser (`make_ocr_corpus.py`)

Written by `uv run python tests/fixtures/make_ocr_corpus.py` with Pillow's bundled default font and saved as image-only PDFs (no text layer), the way a scanner or an image export produces them. Used by `tests/test_ocr.py`; the tests skip when the `tesseract` binary is not installed.

- **`typed_letter.pdf`**: two pages of clean typed text (the sentences in `TYPED` in the generator). Every page must be recognised, with flag `ocr` and a confidence on each page block.
- **`blank_scan.pdf`**: one page of faint noise with no writing. Recognition must yield nothing, so the page stays unreadable with `ocr_no_text` added to `image_only`. This is the fixture that proves the OCR check can fail.

---

## 4. `folder_source/` — Minimal Ingest Tree

Small 4-file nested directory (`alpha.txt`, `beta.txt`, `nested/delta.csv`, `nested/gamma.txt`) copied into `tmp_path` by `tests/test_ingest.py` to test add/change/unchanged/tombstone versioning and blob storage.

---

## Regenerating Fixtures and Goldens

1. **Sample corpus (`real_samples/`):** Edit `tests/fixtures/make_real_samples.py`, run `uv run python tests/fixtures/make_real_samples.py`, verify with `uv run commissure probe tests/fixtures/real_samples --json`, and update `tests/fixtures/real_samples.expected.json`.
2. **Synthetic fixtures (`probe_corpus/`):** Edit `tests/fixtures/make_probe_corpus.py` and run `uv run python tests/fixtures/make_probe_corpus.py`.
3. **Parse goldens (`tests/golden/parse/`):** Run `COMMISSURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 uv run pytest tests/test_parse_golden.py`, then inspect `git diff tests/golden` and new golden files line by line before committing.
